title: I Posted the Silent Treatment Roster After the Group Trip

parts.text: I opened the shared album and saw three days I had paid for and zero photos of me. I am twenty-six, designer, rented van seat, snacks I bought. The trip was supposed to fix a weird year. My friend group had a side chat. I found out because someone added me by accident, then removed me, and iMessage showed the flicker. The cabin smelled like wet wood and nacho cheese. My friend Tasha would not meet my eyes in the kitchen. Tasha said, "Don't make it a thing" I said, "The side chat already is" I had receipts for the groceries. I can still name the ugly little detail, which is how I know it happened. I noticed a scuff on the floor shaped like a comma, which fit i. Someone had left a receipt in the cup holder, faded blue ink. The air tasted like leftover rain and cleaning spray, which fit i. A cheap clock on the wall jumped a minute late, then caught up. I kept my keys in my left pocket so I would not fidget, which fit i. The plastic chair stuck to my legs when I shifted. A vending machine hummed in another room like a bored insect, which fit i. I counted three ceiling tiles with water stains before I spoke again.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The accidental add is still in my notification shade, and the album has my snacks without my face.

parts.text: I sent a calm message with the grocery total and a request: include or refund. Two people refunded immediately, embarrassed. Tasha wrote a speech about energy. I left the cabin a day early in the van that was also mine. They had to Uber, which is petty math. I ate leftover snacks in a rest-stop parking lot under a humming light. The new album of my life has fewer people and more receipts. I am not uninvited from myself. Nacho cheese still makes me laugh, once, meanly, then fondly. The flicker taught me to screenshot fast. Tasha said, "You're punishing us" I said, "I'm driving the van I paid for" Asha, not on the trip, picked me up from the rest stop. She brought a charger. That is a friend.
